summary: Added Bug 1 regression guard test to workflow-handoff.test.ts. Test scenario [impl PASS, qa PASS, code-review FAIL, impl-2 PASS, qa-2 PASS] via makeWpTimed gives sequential timestamps ensuring code-review FAIL started before impl-2 PASS. Result: READY_FOR_QA not IN_PROGRESS. All 2868 tests pass.
